notes: Run each side in both themes (theme: light, then dark). The mirror loads census.js itself; on the docs page load http://localhost:4183/census.js with a script tag and await its onload. Both panes at an 1100px viewport. The reference root carries no marker: it is the list-none column with the red border. The Retry example is the sketch tools/geist/sketch/error-card.retry.json (extract.ts synth), rendered by the mirror after the page's own showcase. width fixes one preview width on both sides, so the card and its full-width children read alike; the title and the Retry label follow the text.
